create_vit_model: create a Vision Transformer with patch merger for image classification given image size, patch size, and number of classes
build_transformer_block: build a transformer block with attention, feedforward layers, and optional patch merging at a configurable layer index
create_attention_module: create a multi-head attention module with query-key-value projection, softmax, and dropout for transformer layers
create_patch_merger: create a patch merger that reduces sequence length using learnable queries and attention over normalized token representations
test_vit_forward_pass: test the ViT forward pass by passing an image tensor through patch embedding, transformer, and classification head
